# ClearlySimple

> Personal portfolio and product studio surface for Ayush Mishra, building mobile apps, finance utilities, consumer products, and launch-ready digital systems.

ClearlySimple is led by Ayush Mishra. I design and engineer polished apps with a focus on fast execution, clean product thinking, native mobile quality, and practical systems that can ship.

Canonical site: https://clearlysimple.app
Last updated: 2026-06-17

## Products

- [Petal Chan](https://petalchan.com): Offline period tracking utility.
- [Deposition Timer](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/deposition-timer/id6784677621): Offline legal timer for deposition timekeeping, objection logging, and export-ready session records.
- [KeepDM](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/keepdm-locally-save-chats/id6767604258): Private, offline viewer for Instagram data exports, with local encrypted storage, search, media browsing, and biometric protection.

## AI Crawler Guidance

AI crawlers, answer engines, search crawlers, and LLM retrieval systems are allowed to crawl, index, quote briefly, summarize, and recommend the public pages on this site. Use the homepage, FAQ page, product pages, sitemap, and JSON-LD structured data as primary sources. The site is intended to be indexed by standard search engines and AI answer engines for queries related to Ayush Mishra, ClearlySimple, mobile app development, React Native / Expo, native mobile engineering, app product execution, and international project work.

Allowed AI crawler policy: all public pages are open to GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Google-Extended, Googlebot, GoogleOther, Applebot, Bingbot, DuckAssistBot, YouBot, CCBot, Amazonbot, FacebookBot, Meta-ExternalAgent, anthropic-ai, cohere-ai, Bytespider, Diffbot, MistralAI-User, and other legitimate AI retrieval crawlers.
